assignedDirection: Playful neo-brutalism for a bouldering and movement gym. Use warm white as the breathing field, electric cobalt for major spatial blocks, clay red for decisive actions, and charcoal for type. Favor huge compressed sans-serif typography, unexpected crops, route-grade symbols, visible grid lines, sticker-like labels, and physical plywood texture. Let sections snap between editorial poster, training diagram, and community noticeboard rhythms. Do not use dark luxury, Swiss emergency-service styling, cinematic architecture pacing, glass cards, fitness-tech gradients, generic black gym branding, or the reference layout one-to-one.
businessBrief:
- Crux Commons is a fictional bouldering and movement gym serving Oakland and Emeryville, California. Do not claim a street address.
- Phone: (510) 555-0136. Email: hello@cruxcommons.com.
- Primary action: Book a first climb.
- Services: Day Passes; Intro to Bouldering; Movement Coaching; Youth Programs.
- Audience: first-time climbers, returning climbers building technique, families, and Oakland residents looking for an active community space.
- Natural SEO vocabulary: bouldering gym Oakland, indoor climbing Oakland, beginner climbing classes Oakland, youth climbing Oakland.
- Never invent certifications, memberships or prices, opening hours, age minimums, class schedules, staff, review scores, route-setting frequency, facility size, equipment inclusions, guarantees, or injury-prevention claims.
assetBrief:
- Use only /assets/hero-climb.png, /assets/chalk-detail.png, and /assets/route-coaching.png for imagery.

interactionBrief: - The purposeful interaction must be a route-finder for visitor intent with choices for First climb, Build technique, Train strength, and Climb with family. A selection must visibly update a concise recommended starting path and a relevant next action. Keep it an honest frontend demonstration and never imply that a booking was delivered.
